insight: Founded 2017 and backed by Greylock, ICONIQ, and F-Prime; deployed at 10,000+ sites of care automating 1M+ workflows a day.
name: Notable
tagline: AI platform that automates healthcare operations and patient access.
description: Notable is an AI platform purpose-built for healthcare that automates administrative and clinical workflows through AI agents. Its low-code Flow Builder lets teams design automations and its natural-language Sidekick assistant runs them across patient access, scheduling, intake, prior authorizations, revenue cycle, and care-gap closure. Deployed across health systems and plans including CommonSpirit, MUSC, and UC San Diego Health.
